pending.task: Site Audit Module (Pipeline 0) — full 6-step deterministic website audit across 8 dimensions
pending.test_total: ~1850+ collected (636 site audit + 1207 existing passed + 135 skipped)
pending.summary: Complete site audit module (Pipeline 0) built by 4-teammate agent team. 8-dimension website audit (crawlability, performance, on-page SEO, extractability/AEO, schema markup, E-E-A-T, freshness, security). 6-step pipeline: s1_discover (async BFS crawler with robots.txt/sitemap/RSS/BFS phases + AI bot detection) → s2_analyze_pages (parallel page analysis with semaphore control) → s3_check_schema (JSON-LD detection with @graph handling) → s4_check_aeo (AEO readiness scoring 0-100) → s5_aggregate (penalty-based scoring, grade computation A-F) → s6_report (Markdown + JSON output). 100% deterministic — no LLM calls. Penalty-based scoring: start at 100, deduct by severity (critical=10, high=5, medium=2, low=1, info=0). Weighted dimensions sum to 1.0. Grade thresholds: A≥90, B≥75, C≥60, D≥40, F<40. API layer: 6 endpoints (start, status, list/detail/findings/pages). Service protocol + JSON filesystem implementation. 636 tests across 10 test files.
